p: A smooth trip starts at home. Fill in your waivers online before you set off, and check your booking time so nobody misses the start of the session. Bring water, wear comfy clothes and hang on to your grip socks afterwards, as they can usually be reused next time.

Norwich Market is one of the best ways to refuel afterwards. Its colourful striped stalls sit right in the heart of the city, below City Hall, with everything from chips and street food to fresh produce and gifts. It's lively, cheerful and a great place to grab lunch on the go.

Norwich Cathedral is another must, with a soaring spire and peaceful cloisters, and it's well known for the peregrine falcons that nest on the spire in spring and summer. Over at the University of East Anglia, the Sainsbury Centre has an impressive art collection in a striking building, and the surrounding parkland is good for a walk.

For a bigger adventure, the Norfolk Broads are just a short trip east of the city. This network of rivers and lakes is perfect for a boat trip, with day boats for hire in places like Wroxham and Hoveton. Spotting wildlife from the water is a lovely calm contrast to the bounce-fest of the morning.
